aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome for Android led browser versions (tablet) in Saudi Arabia at 45.86% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari iPad ranked second at 26.2%, followed by Chrome iPad at 12.57%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browser versions (tablet) in Saudi Arabia?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android leads at 45.86% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-version-market-share/tablet/saudi-arabia.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browser versions (tablet) in Saudi Arabia?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android (45.86%), Safari iPad (26.2%), Chrome iPad (12.57%) in October 2026.
